_comment: Two variables, because the REST path carries the account:
POST {baseUrl}/accounts/{CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID}/ai/run/{model}.
MEASURED, 02.09: text to image only. Every img2img route was tried and
none is open on this account -- sd-1.5-img2img answers 403 'not allowed',
SDXL and sdxl-lightning reject the image tensor outright, flux-1-schnell
403s on it, and the Leonardo models 400/422. So the layout guides cannot
condition anything here, which was the whole reason to expect this
provider to suit the guided half of the plate pipeline. It does not.
Free daily allocation, then per-neuron billing. No per-image table.

pollinations.label: Pollinations
_comment: MEASURED, 02.09. Text to image only: /models lists exactly one model on
this key, and the img2img-capable ones (kontext, gptimage) are higher
tiers. An image= parameter is accepted and IGNORED, which is worse than
an error -- it returns a plausible picture that owes nothing to the
reference.
What it alone can do: draw at the plate's real aspect. 1065x240, which
is 4.44:1, comes back as 1065x240, where OpenAI refuses anything past
3:1 and has to be tiled and stitched. There is a pixel ceiling, though:
2130x480 at the same ratio comes back 1617x364, scaled down silently
rather than refused, so always check the size that arrived.

models.label: SANA -- text to image, arbitrary aspect
models.note: Free tier. Honours a plate's 4.44:1 exactly.

_comment: Settings for the sdapi providers above. The ControlNet model conditions a
generated albedo on an ALREADY AUTHORED height map (gen.py --height), so
paint lands in the grooves the mesh will actually have. Note the direction:
height is never estimated from the art -- estimation was measured useless on
this project's pixel work -- it is authored by tools/asset-gen/heightgen.py
and the picture is made to agree with it.
